After I clicked "+ Read later" the card showed it was now in my read-later pile (the button changed to show it's added) and the read-later count went up, while the page still stayed in my main collection — so I haven't lost it from everything else. And I can see there's a separate read-later view where I can mark something as read to take it off that list. That's exactly the set-aside-and-come-back habit I wanted.

Between the choices, variation A — the "+ Read later" button — reads the most plainly to me, so I'm happy to settle on that one. This covers the read-later flow well.
